description: This file defines the ShiftRequest document class and related validation and processing methods for handling employee shift requests within the ERPNext HR module.

classes.name: OverlapError
classes.description: Custom validation error class for shift request overlaps.

classes.name: ShiftRequest
classes.description: Main document class for handling employee shift requests, including validation, submission, cancellation, and overlap checks.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs various validation checks on the shift request, including employee activity, date validity, overlap, approver, and default shift.

methods.name: on_update
methods.description: Shares the document with the approver upon update.

methods.name: on_submit
methods.description: Creates a shift assignment if the request is approved, and displays a confirmation message.

methods.name: on_cancel
methods.description: Cancels related shift assignments when the shift request is canceled.

methods.name: validate_default_shift
methods.description: Ensures the employee is not requesting their default shift.

methods.name: validate_approver
methods.description: Validates that the selected approver is authorized for the employee's department.

methods.name: validate_dates
methods.description: Checks that the 'to' date is not before the 'from' date.

methods.name: validate_shift_request_overlap_dates
methods.description: Checks for overlapping shift requests for the same employee.

methods.name: throw_overlap_error
methods.description: Raises an overlap error with a detailed message.
